mono-0314.d: Dot-matrix ring on a fine LED grid. Soft gradients, hard dots.

mono-0346.d: One-point perspective corridor, frames receding deep into the distance, rays packed tight. Brutalism, but make it comfortable.

mono-0351.d: Crowded skyline of solid towers with grids of windows. Looks planned, because it was.

mono-0352.d: Dense concentric squares, twisting slowly inward. The kind of print that ages well.

mono-0362.d: Two overlapping primary forms, reduced to pure geometry. Shapes doing very little, very well.

mono-0396.d: Cantilevered stack of concrete slabs, a few poured solid. Grid discipline, worn casually.
